title: 剑与火 · 旅途地图重制
deliverable: Original editable design mockup plus Cocos implementation, actual Web runtime screenshots and validation report. HTML interactions remain isolated design fixtures.

type.heading: Songti SC / STSong, serif; matches character/equipment page

design.layout: Full-screen landscape atlas; narrow header; map at left and one compact waypoint column at right; legends are a temporary overlay.
distinctiveChoices: Use existing game geography as the dominant surface, with dark feathered exploration fog.
Put all discovered waypoint destinations in a dedicated travel column; remove quest and experience clutter.
Use warm gold only for hierarchy, selections and the travel action; violet rune symbols identify teleport destinations.
Place return at top left, leaving the top-right platform capsule clear.
Reuse the implemented equipment page leather, double-gold frame, active underline, rounded selection outline and gold action artwork.
design.review: Kept the established warm-gold game theme. Replaced the permanent left legend and journal sidebar with a larger map plus destination list; no generic dashboard cards.

safeArea.rule: Use the runtime safe rectangle and capsule rectangle, converted into the same layout coordinate space. Decorative terrain may bleed; text, controls and hit areas remain inside the safe rectangle and outside the capsule.
safeArea.previewInsets: Injected design fixtures only, not measured hardware values. Rotate fixture swaps the island to the other short edge.
safeArea.acceptance: Check both landscape orientations, actual platform capsule, safe-rectangle changes, all visible and invisible touch areas, and device touch behavior. Browser fixtures do not establish device compatibility.

fastTravel.eligibility: Only authored, personally discovered and unlocked teleport destinations; visiting an arbitrary area is insufficient.
fastTravel.flow: Select a map rune or list destination, then press the single travel button. No trip to a departure rune and no additional confirmation dialog.
fastTravel.scope: All unlocked destinations, including other authored regions. The mock shows Rockforge Town, Brokenpeak Waystation and Stonebridge Town.
blocked: Nearby combat or active hostile projectiles
Transaction or reward submission in progress
Destination no longer available or not unlocked
states: Failure keeps the selection and offers retry
fastTravel.noSideEffects: Travel must not restock shops, reset encounters, restore resources, grant rewards or advance quests.
fastTravel.mockNotice: The HTML mock uses demonstration records. Actual Cocos fast travel now validates durable discovery and authored safe destinations in GameSession.

limits: Map marks and discovery shapes are illustrative design placements, not collision or navigation coordinates.
